verdict.rationale: Clerk's docs list an authenticator application (TOTP) and backup codes as second-factor strategies. When MFA is enabled, sign-in returns needs_second_factor, and a changelog entry describes a customizable reverification window for sensitive actions, which serves as step-up enforcement. The MFA pricing listing confirms it is a first-party feature, though one community comment notes it adds cost. missing for 10: explicit documentation that MFA enrollment can be made mandatory for all users, in-depth docs on reverification/step-up configuration (only a changelog line), independent or hands-on corroboration.
